text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen. Haru Urara is frazzled by her own shaky and sweaty body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that means she's taking this race seriously. Finally realizing what taking something seriously means…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads off to the race with the heartfelt goal of taking home first place.
